decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the distributor's established knowledge of print finishing workflows and still has its own website page in 2024, so the firm can interpret its results and keep integrating it with its finishing lines.

The folding add-on complements the Multigraf creasing and cutting systems the firm already knows well, and a documented customer installation (Kolumbus) shows it works in practice, so the firm can use this field feedback rather than drop it.
